description: The objective of the contract is to provide services to support the Energy Efficient transformation of existing public buildings conducted by the General Directorate of Construction Affairs to achieve the 2053 targets for Carbon Neutral Türkiye. In this context, the energy consumption of existing public buildings will be evaluated, and innovative solutions to improve energy performance will be searched. Using dedicated software, an energy passport system will be developed to increase the energy performance of public buildings. Within the scope of this contract, which aims to support the energy efficiency sector and to use financial mechanisms effectively, consultancy services will be provided to create a sustainable model for increasing the energy performance of existing public buildings with the cooperation of relevant stakeholders.

description: Le présent marché vise à servir la direction D «Lieu de travail intermédiaire» de prestataires de services individuels, de groupements de prestataires de services individuels, cliniques, cabinets médicaux ou associations momentanées de médecins habités dans les domaines du contrôle médical des absences pour accident et maladie. La médecine de contrôle préalable est définie par l’activité médicale exercée par un médecin autorisé et pour le compte d’un employeur en vue de contrôler l’impossibilité pour un travailleur de fournir son travail par suite de maladie ou d’accident. CET appel d’offres concertées des prestations liées aux contrôles médicaux des absences pour accident et maladie du personnel de la Commission européenne affectée en Belgique, Luxembourg et Italie depuis, ement, les sites de Bruxelles, Luxembourg ville et Ispra (Varese, Italie).

The European Court of Auditors, the Court of Justice of the European Union, the Committee of the Regions, the European Economic and Social Committee, the European Ombudsman, the European Data Protection Supervisor and the Translation Centre for the Bodies of the European Union have responded positively.

conditionOfParticipation: {"id":958338,"cft_id":803,"publishedDate":null,"language":"EN","excCrit":"reminder of the exclusion criteria — Articles 106 and 107 of the Financial Regulation:Article 106:1. candidates or tenderers shall be excluded from participation in procurement procedures if:(a) they are bankrupt or being wound up, are having their affairs administered by the courts, have entered Selection criteria for the manufacture and supply of products:a. Criterion CS-MAN01 — Be a manufacturer of control products and technical building management information systems:1.1.1. Definition of the criterion:§1. The candidate must be a manufacturer of control products and TBM IT systems (automation and supervision).A manufacturer means any natural person or legal entity that designs and manufactures a product, or has a product designed or manufactured, and markets that product in its name or trademark. The candidate may be a representative of the manufacturer, i.e. any natural person or legal entity established in Europe (EU28) who has received written authorisation from the manufacturer to act exclusively in its name to carry out specific tasks.§2. The products and systems proposed for this contract must:(a) cover all 3 of the following levels (examples of product types by level):— 'Management' (TBM monitoring and supervision software)— 'Automation' (digital building controllers, digital controllers for primary or secondary applications, digital controllers for terminal applications, system controllers for integration),— 'Site': (sensors and actuators);(b) be of the same brand, as a minimum for the 'Management' and 'Automation' levels;(c) be compatible with each other in a functional architecture,— applicable for the technological fields related to buildings such as heating, ventilation, air conditioning, blinds, water and sanitation, electricity distribution, lighting, refrigeration for catering, management of energy and water flows,— applicable for all tertiary buildings (≥ 3 units) (offices, computer rooms, conference rooms, catering establishments), of which some are very large (≥ 80 000 m2 building), at one geographical site (Brussels, European District),— including in particular 5 product types listed and detailed in criterion CS-MAN02.§3. Manufacturing services for products and systems in the 'Management' and 'Automation' levels may not be subcontracted.1.1.2. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-MAN01]The candidate shall prove that he is a manufacturer of the following type:§1. [MANident] By providing a table showing:— the functional TBM architecture into which the products and systems proposed for the contract are integrated,— the brand or brands of these products and systems,— which levels — 'Management', 'Automation' and 'Site' — are covered (yes/no) by the products and systems for each brand,— the name of each manufacturing entity of the candidate proposed for the manufacture of these products and systems. If a manufacturing entity is subcontracted, the candidate shall specify it.Example:Architecture brand compatible with the architecture levels name of the manufacturing entityManagement Automation SiteArch.XYZ Brand A X (yes) - - Man.entity.1- X (yes) X (yes) Man.entity.2Brand B - X (yes) Man.entity.3Brand C - X (yes) Man.entity.4 (subcontracted)§2. [MANresp] By providing, per entity, at least one relevant document demonstrating that it assumes any responsibilities arising from the manufacture of products and systems in the functional architecture proposed for the contract. For example, if the candidate is the manufacturer's representative, this document may be the written authorisation from the manufacturer to act exclusively in its name, or simply a solemn declaration signed and dated by the entity's representative.b. Criterion CS-MAN02 — Manufacture and supply specific product types required for the contract:i. Definition of the criterion:§1. For this contract, each candidate must provide, for each of the 5 product types listed below and meeting selection criterion CS-MAN01 and the following minimum requirements:Product type No 1 — 'TBM monitoring and supervision software' ('Management' level):— the number of addressable points (physical and data, including terminal control) in the system that the software should be able to handle is at least 150 000 (if the candidate is applying for one lot only: 1 or 2), or at least 300 000 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2),— the capacity of the database (alarm history, incidence history, records and trends) is not limited.Product type No 2 — 'Digital building controller' ('Automation' level):— this product type enables the management and coordination, on a BACnet/MSTP or BACnet/LonTalk subnet, of a set of controllers in the 'Automation' level, while connected with the 'Management' level in BACnet via VLAN Ethernet IP,— it enables at least 30 controllers to connect to the subnet,— it provides the subnet with calendar and scheduling functions, as well as recording and trend functions,— it incorporates a real-time clock,— it can be configured if several similar devices are available on the site, in order to coordinate data display,— it is fitted with an embedded web server allowing multiple simultaneous connections.Product type No 3 — 'Digital controller for primary and secondary applications ('Automation' level):— this product type is suitable for HVAC applications (such as the control of air handling units, boiler rooms, refrigeration units and cooling towers, collectors and pumps, etc.),— it is connected (upstream) to a digital building controller in a BACnet/MSTP or BACnet/LonTalk subnet in the 'Automation' level,— it is freely programmable,— it incorporates a real-time clock,— its capacity (possibly with exit/entry module extensions) is above or equal to 48 physical points (≥ 24 BI and ≥ 8 BO and ≥ 8 AI and ≥ 8AO),— it includes (or enables connection to) a human-machine interface (LCD display and control/navigation buttons).Product type No 4 — 'Digital controller for terminal applications' ('Automation' level):— it is suitable for HVAC applications such as the control of terminal units (4-tube fan coil with motion sensor and window contact, lighting control relay),— it is connected (upstream) to a digital building controller in a BACnet/MSTP or BACnet/LonTalk subnet in the 'Automation' level,— its capacity (possibly with exit/entry module extensions) is above or equal to 8 physical points (≥ 2 BI and ≥ 3 BO and ≥ 1 AI and ≥ 2AO).Product type No 5 — 'Integration system controller' ('Automation' level):— this product type enables the management and coordination, on a LonWorks or KNX subnet, of a set of controllers in the 'Automation' level, while connected with the 'Management' level in BACnet via VLAN Ethernet IP,— it enables at least 30 controllers to connect to the subnet,— it provides the subnet with calendar and scheduling functions, as well as recording and trend functions,— it incorporates a real-time clock.ii. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-MAN02]The candidate must provide, for each of the 5 product types listed above, a technical sheet summary in his name.Each technical sheet [MANprodtypn] (numbered from 1 to 5) shall be supplemented with:— the references of the products concerned,— the main technical characteristics, functions and capacities, to enable verification of compliance with the minimum requirements described above,— in Annex I, the declaration of performance (Regulation (EU) No 305/2011 of the European Parliament and of the Council 'Construction Products') or, where appropriate, the corresponding attestation of conformity (Directive 89/106/EEC of the Council 'Construction Products' amended by Directive 93/68/EEC of the Council). If the label 'BTL Listed' is not on the PICS, the candidate must demonstrate that the product type has been tested in accordance with ISO 16484-6 and the Certification Rules of 'BACnet Interest Group Europe'. Selection criteria for installation, configuration, programming and commissioning:a. Criterion CS-INST01 — Be an authorised contractor for building electricity and IT equipment:i. Definition of the criterion:§1. The candidate is an authorised and ranked works contractor, currently and for at least 5 years from the date of publication of the contract notice, in accordance with the provisions of the the Belgian Ministerial Decree of 27.9.1991 (or equivalent in the candidate's country of origin) in each of the following categories and classes:— Category P1 'Electrical installations in buildings': class 4 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or class 3 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2),— Category S4 'IT equipment': class 4 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or class 3 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).§2. Subcontracting of installation services is permitted.ii. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-INST01]:§1. [INSTentragr] For each installing entity that the candidate proposes for the contract, he shall provide copies proving that the contractor is authorised for the period and as described above.§2. [INSTresp] Should it propose several installing entities, the candidate shall indicate for each entity the type of relationship, tasks and responsibilities that it is planning with this entity. If one of the installing entities proposed is a subcontractor, the applicant shall indicate it here.b. Criterion CS-INST02 — Have already installed control products and TBM systems:i. Definition of the criterion:The candidate shall provide proof of his capacity to install control products and TBM systems, by demonstrating that he has provided 2 works services in the past.Works reference No 1 — Carrying out new works:— in a single building,— the value of the works is at least 400 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or at least 200 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).Works reference No 2 — Carrying out renovation works:— in one or more buildings, all occupied during the works,— the value of the works is at least 640 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or at least 320 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).Each reference submitted shall have the following characteristics as a minimum:— the works must have been accepted (provisional acceptance or equivalent) in the 5 years prior to the date of publication of the contract notice,— the works must have been carried out in a Member State of the European Union (EU28),— the works must involve:• electrical installations (cabling and electrical switchboards, installation and connection of electrical fixtures, commissioning and operational tests);• for control products and TBM IT systems (automation and supervision),— TBM products and systems must cover at least the 2 following levels:• 'Management';• 'Automation',— the applications covered by the products and TBM systems must refer to at least 3 of the 4 following technological fields related to buildings:(a) heating/ventilation/air conditioning/blinds/water and sanitation;(b) electricity distribution/lighting;(c) refrigeration for catering;(d) management of energy and water flows,— the works must be subject to a certificate of satisfactory performance, signed and dated by the client,— the total treated surface area is at least 24 000 m2 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or at least 12 000 m2 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2),— the number of points addressed and managed in the new installation exceeds 4 800 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or 2 400 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).ii. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-INST02]:The candidate must provide, for each reference given above, a summary [INSTreftravn] (with Nos 1 or 2) specifying as a minimum:— the start date for services and the date of provisional acceptance,— the place of performance,— the purpose of the services,— the control and TBM products placed, their references and numbers, the levels ('management', 'automation', 'site') and the technological fields covered,— the number of points (physical and data, including terminal control),— the attestations of conformity and satisfactory performance,— the value (including items and workforce) (excluding taxes), broken down into:— the electrician works on the one hand,— and on the other, the supply of automatons, IT equipment and software, and control and automation services,— the total surface area of the buildings concerned (surface area of floors, including basements),— the name or names of the installing entities proposed for this contract who have carried out works, by specifying those who provided:• electrician services (electrical switchboards, electrical fixtures, automatons, sensors and actuators, cabling);• control and automation services (programming, adjustments and optimisations, operational tests, networks, servers);• effective and compliant commissioning, with attestation of conformity with the manufacturer's specifications.The European Parliament reserves the right to conduct a site visit (with a detailed report) to verify the supporting documents.3. Selection criteria for maintenance:a. Criterion CS-MAINT01 — Possess a maintenance service:i. Definition of the criterion:§1. The candidate shall possess a maintenance service (or after-sales) which has the following characteristics and capacities as a minimum:— operating for at least 3 years from the date of publication of the contract notice,— able to visit the customer on-site, in the Brussels-Capital Region, at the latest by 12 noon the next business day after the first telephone call,— able to work in a working language of the future contract, i.e. French or English,— skilled with the manufacturer's control products and TBM IT systems (automation and supervision),— able to intervene in problems involving both hardware (control, IT) and software (TBM, networks) and cover the 3 levels — 'Management', 'Automation' and 'Site',— comply with the requirements of the manufacturer,— have a trained and experienced FTE staff (full-time time equivalents,1 750 hours/year), including at least 2 engineers and at least 5 senior technicians.§2. Subcontracting of maintenance services is permitted, but only for tasks relating to maintenance levels 1 to 3 in accordance with Standard FDX 60-000:2002.ii. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-MAINT01][MAINTsvrmaint] The candidate shall communicate the names and particulars of the maintenance entity or entities proposed for the contract. He shall present detailed information about each entity in order to demonstrate full compliance with criterion CS-MAINT01.If maintenance services are subcontracted, the candidate shall indicate the name of the subcontracted maintenance entity, specifying the subcontracted services and responsibilities.b. Criterion CS-MAINT02 — Have already carried out maintenance of control products and TBM systems:i. Definition of the criterion:The candidate shall prove his capacity to carry out the maintenance of control products and TBM IT systems by demonstrating that he has performed 2 maintenance contracts (or orders) in the past.Each reference submitted shall have the following characteristics as a minimum:— the maintenance services lasted at least 1 year and were carried out during the past 3 years from the date of publication of the contract notice,— the maintenance services were carried out in a Member State of the European Union (EU28),— the maintenance services must have involved control products and TBM IT systems covering at least 3 of the 4 following technological fields related to buildings:(a) heating/ventilation/air conditioning/blinds/water and sanitation;(b) electricity distribution/lighting;(c) refrigeration for catering;(d) management of energy and water flows;— the number of points addressed and managed in the installation to be maintained exceeds 40 000 (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or 20 000 (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2),— the maintenance services must have involved systematic preventive maintenance operations, with tasks in maintenance level 4 or 5 in accordance with Standard FDX 60-000:2002,— the maintenance services must have been subject to a certificate of satisfactory performance, signed and dated by the customer,— the maintenance services must have amounted to a total annual value of at least 125 000 EUR (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or 62 500 EUR (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2),— the maintenance services must have been carried out with the on-site presence of control technicians with 3 years of experience (in maintenance customer site): at least 1 FTE (full-time equivalent, 1750 hours/year) (if the candidate is applying for both lots: 1 and 2) or at least 0,5 FTE (if the candidate is applying for 1 lot only: 1 or 2).ii. Supporting documents to be submitted [CS-MAINT02]The candidate must provide, for each reference given above, a summary [MAINTreftravn] (with Nos 1 or 2) specifying as a minimum:— the start and end dates of the services,— the place of performance,— the purpose of the services,— the control and TBM products placed, their numbers and the technological fields covered,— the number of points (physical and data, including terminal control),— the maintenance operations carried out,— a list of any potential subcontractors or partners,— the attestations of conformity and satisfactory performance,— the annual value of services (including items and workforce) (excluding taxes),— the number of FTE employees working at the customer's site,— the name of the entity which carried out the maintenance, and the list of possible subcontractors or partners.","accProc":null}
description: The aim of the contract is the signature of a framework contract in order to carry out works with maintenance services in the field of centralised technical management for European Parliament buildings in Brussels.The contractor shall install, program and provide maintenance for a new technical building management system (TBMS) at the European Parliament site in Brussels.Candidates will apply in their capacities as a:— manufacturer,— installer,— maintenance provider.Entities of the candidate with these capacities are hereinafter referred to as 'the manufacturing entity', 'the installing entity' and 'the maintenance entity'.The European Parliament's maintenance services in Brussels want a contractor who is the sole contact and fits the following profile:— is a manufacturer in the field of control and technical building management.The manufacturing capacities are internal and cannot be subcontracted,— is an expert, by way of its products and services, in applications such as heating, ventilation, air conditioning, electricity distribution and lighting,— is able to take responsibility for carrying out the works assignments and maintenance summarised above:• by coordinating with other third parties, internal services or European Parliament contractors who are responsible for maintaining or fitting technical installations related to control and TBM;• by advising the European Parliament's building maintenance services in order to comply with and meet the contractual objectives.It is required to ensure, for the duration of the contract:— the reverse compatibility of all terminal control equipment that has already been installed when new equipment is commissioned,— the homogeneity and uniqueness of the technical building management system, integrating several CTM subsystems and based on BACNet.The contract covers all buildings occupied by the European Parliament in Brussels and is divided into 2 lots. Candidates may tender either for one of the 2 lots (lot 1, lot 2) or for both lots (lot 1 and lot 2).During the course of the contract, the European Parliament reserves the right to withdraw or to add site buildings to either of the 2 lots.

lots:
[{"number":"1","title":"Travel agency services relating to missions and authorised trips","description":"This contract is for the provision of all travel agency services, including the provision of an online booking tool, relating to the business trips of any person travelling on behalf of or at the request of the Institutions, regardless of their geographical location. This in particular relates to the heads of mission (including the president of the European Council, the president and the members of the European Commission, including the Union’s high representative for foreign affairs and security policy, and vice-president of the European Commission), experts, and competitive examination winners or candidates.
                  These services will be performed at the contractor's own premises, provided for this purpose. Since the majority of trips are from Belgium, an operating entity of the contractor will be located in Belgium, in order to take into account the need for close coordination, rapid intervention in emergency or crisis situations, monitoring and control in close cooperation with the Institutions that are mainly located in Belgium. The agency must provide a staff member who will be required to work on the premises of the European Commission to act as liaison officer. He/she will be located on the premises of the Office for the Administration and Payment of Individual Entitlements (PMO), in charge of managing the contract in Brussels (Belgium).
                  The contract, which will be based on payments per transaction, has an estimated annual volume of:
                  — 77 000 airline tickets,
                  — 38 000 train tickets,
                  — 80 000 hotel reservations (of which approximately 93% are made directly by the traveller through accommodation facilities or reservation websites).
                  This corresponds to approximately 134 000 business trips for a population of 24 000 travellers. In 2017, the adoption rate of the on-line booking tool (OBT) at the European Commission was around 7%. The balance corresponds to reservations by phone or email.
                  This invitation to tender is organised on an interinstitutional basis. The contracting authority responsible for the procedure is the European Commission. The European Commission, representing the institutions, will make a single award decision for all of them. Afterwards, a framework interinstitutional service contract will be signed by the European Commission, represented by the Director of the PMO. The European Commission will be the main contractor, responsible for managing the framework contract, and representing in this regard all the participating contracting authorities. The operational aspects of the contract will be the responsibility of each participating contracting authority, acting in complete autonomy.
                  This framework contract will apply to all the institutions designated as contracting authorities below which have given a mandate in this regard. This list will not be altered except in the event of the creation or acquisition of financial autonomy of an institution subsequent to the publication of this contract notice in the Official Journal of the European Union.
                  In such cases, the new institution may also benefit from the services under the framework contract on condition that, on the one hand, it is authorised by the Commission on the basis of information regarding its legal personality and the legal basis of its creation and, on the other hand, that the value of any future contracts would not exceed 10% of the contract volume as indicated in the technical specifications (all institutions, bodies and agencies taken together). The rider enabling the new institution to adhere to the framework contract will be signed and managed by the European Commission.
                  A reserve of 10% for unforeseen needs and additional services will also be taken into account to define the contract volume (full description available via the link mentioned in point I.3).","nuts":[],"additionalCpvs":[],"estimatedValue":null,"awardMethod":"1","lng":null},{"number":"2","title":"Travel agency services relating to the organisation of meetings and events","description":"The subject of the contract includes the coordinated provision of all travel agency services relating to the organisation by the Institution of meetings or events, for the business trips of all persons, including, if the case may be, those external to the organising Institution, travelling on behalf of or at the request of said Institution, regardless of their geographical location.
                  These services will be performed at the contractor's own premises, provided for this purpose. Since the majority of meetings and events are organised in Belgium, an operating entity of the contractor will be located in Belgium, in order to take into account the need for close coordination, rapid intervention in emergency or crisis situations, monitoring and control in close cooperation with the Institutions that are mainly located in Belgium.
                  The contract, which will be based on payments per transaction, has an estimated annual volume of:
                  — 17 000 airline tickets,
                  — 5 500 train tickets,
                  — 8 300 hotel reservations.
                  For an estimated annual number of 39 000 business trips and 1 500 meetings or events.
                  This invitation to tender is organised on an interinstitutional basis. The contracting authority responsible for the procedure is the European Commission. The European Commission, representing the institutions, will make a single award decision for all of them. Afterwards, a framework interinstitutional service contract will be signed by the European Commission, represented by the Director of the PMO. The European Commission will be the main contractor, responsible for managing the framework contract, and representing in this regard all the participating contracting authorities. The operational aspects of the contract will be the responsibility of each participating contracting authority, acting in complete autonomy.
                  This framework contract will apply to all the institutions designated as contracting authorities below which have given a mandate in this regard. This list will not be altered except in the event of the creation or acquisition of financial autonomy of an institution subsequent to the launch of this contract.
                  In such cases, the new institution may also benefit from the services under the framework contract on condition that, on the one hand, it is authorised by the Commission on the basis of information regarding its legal personality and the legal basis of its creation and, on the other hand, that the value of any future contracts would not exceed 10% of the contract volume (all institutions, bodies and agencies taken together). The rider enabling the new institution to adhere to the framework contract will be signed and managed by the European Commission.
                  A reserve of 10% for unforeseen needs and additional services will also be taken into account to define the contract volume.

description:
The objective of the call for tenders is to set up a framework contract with a provider in order to rent (housing) a secured data center space (Disaster Recovery site) for the needs of the General Secretariat of the Council (GSC). The purpose of the contract is also to provide data center services regarding the Disaster Recovery site (including office space, assembly room and storage room).
               Today, the GSC runs its infrastructure in 2 data centers, one in the Justus Lipsius building (175 rue de la Loi — 1048 Brussels, Belgium) and the other one in the LEX building (145 rue de la Loi — 1048 Brussels, Belgium). The 2 data centers are too close to each other and therefore the present call for tenders has been launched to move the data center situated in the LEX building to the new Disaster Recovery site.
               Following the call for tenders, a framework contract will be awarded with an initial duration of 4 years, with the possibility of 4 extensions of 1 year each.

description:
DPS for training services to EIF Staff for professional and personal development, in the following categories:
- Soft skills (4 categories)
- Languages
- Corporate / Business related skills
- IT skills
- Individual coaching
The DPS also include a category for training facilities.
title: Provision of training services to EIF Staff members for professional and personal development

description: The objective of this technical assistance is to implement the gaza central desalination programme on time, on budget and at high quality. The Programme Management Support Consultancy (PMSC) will be embedded in the overall programme management structure. It will support the Palestinian Water Authority (PWA) in programme management and provide guidance during the procurement, design, construction and commissioning phase of the Gaza Central Desalination Programme (GCDP), leading to the Program’s successful implementation and handover to the operational phase. Additionally, this TA aims to enable the long-term operational effectiveness of the GCDP by delivering and implementing a results-driven capacity-building plan to Programme Management Unit that manages and leads the implementation of the GCDP. The estimated duration of the programme is up to 36 months. Up to 3 senior international key experts with experience in managing large water infrastructure Programme will be mobilized.

description:
Le Parlement européen est en quête d’une société bancaire qui reprenne une agence bancaire située dans le bâtiment Altiero SPINELLI et un espace situé dans le bâtiment Paul Henri SPAAK, avec l’obligation accessoire de réaliser des services de paiements aux groupes des visiteurs du Parlement européen. 
L’agence situé dans la galerie intérieure du rez-de-chaussée du bâtiment Altiero SPINELLI du Parlement européen à Bruxelles a une surface de 120 m2.
L’agence situé au rez de chaussée du bâtiment Paul Henri SPAAK a une surface de 85 m2.
Le contrat de concession sera conclu pour une durée de sept années pour l’agence située dans le bâtiment SPINELLI et de 3 années pour l’agence située dans le bâtiment SPAAK.
A l’expiration de la période de trois (3) ans pour l’espace situé dans le bâtiment SPAAK, le Parlement européen pourra mettre à la disposition du contractant un autre espace situé dans le bâtiment ZWEIG pour quatre (4) renouvellements consécutifs d’une année.

description: The Secretariat – composed of a FT Director, Private Sector Dev. Specialist, Admin./ Logistics/driver assistants, and PT Trade and Investment Advisor, ad-hoc experts and IT/Com. expert – will support the SB4U Platform (launched by the President of Uganda in March 2020). The SB4U Platform aims: to structure a PPP dialogue, to improve investment climate (green and sustainable), to steer economic reforms and implementing measures, to strengthen business and trade partnerships between domestic and European companies by producing market information and coordinating missions and events. Actions will: target potential investors to Uganda, create synergies with relevant interventions and policy (with EU Dev. Financing Institutions, with Uganda and EU Member States trade agencies or with existing PPP mechanisms such as the Presidential Investors’ Round Table). The contractor will also be responsible for organising and financing under this contract an Int. Business Forum and other events.

description: The action aims to continue the ongoing cooperation between the EU and China on policies tackling climate change, in particular on emissions trading, building on the existing cooperation on emissions trading.This action will support the implementation of the annual policy dialogue on emissions trading as agreed in the Memorandum of Understanding on ETS cooperation signed at the China-EU summit in July 2018, including through joint policy research activities designed to provide appropriate and effective solutions to challenges of the Chinese ETS. Furthermore, the action entails important technical knowledge sharing elements to further support China in building up and successfully establishing its nation-wide emission trading system. Specific tasks will include: information and management services, technical assessments and research, organization of specific training activities with a focus on a ‘train-the-trainer approach’.

description: The purpose of this contract is to improve the sustainability and efficiency of social and health care systems for the elderly with a focus on quality home care and day care services. To this aim, an elderly care model will be developed and various sub-activities such as swot analysis, desk studies, focus groups meetings, etc. will be conducted for design of the model. Also, pilot implementation of the model will be carried out. Apart from these, training modules will be prepared and trainings will be delivered to training of trainers and service providers working in elderly care services. Besides, awareness raising activities will be organised; studies will be conducted and other activities such as organising summit on elderly policies, gathering local steering committees will be arranged.

The writing/editorial support will cover the following non-exhaustive list of tasks:

(a) writing and editing Clean Sky key messages and texts on projects and activities for CS2JU and the future research programme in close cooperation with CS2JU's programme unit and external partners;

(b) publishing agreed content with the Head of Communications of Clean Sky 2 JU on www.cleansky.eu with web support;

(c) editing and proofreading (in English) of CS2JU documents;

(d) press work: the writing/editorial support will also include work on CS2JU's press and media activities, including:

• writing, editing and sending press releases and articles;

• organising press events such as press conferences and press briefings, maintaining a database of journalists; and

• supporting media partnerships, under the lead of the Head of Communications of CS2JU.

Experience in media monitoring is considered an advantage in areas such as analysis of press and analytics, contractor selection, etc.;

(e) other tasks and activities according to the development of CS2JU structure or activities, including covering for other members of the communications team on digital tasks and others in case of absence, and under the direction of the Head of Communications.

description: Le présent marché porte sur la mobilisation d’une assistance technique, afin d'appuyer la gestion et la mise en œuvre du programme Msomo Na Hazi — formation et insertion professionnelle — en Union des Comores. L'objectif du projet est de faire évoluer durablement l’offre de formation pour mieux répondre aux besoins du marché de travail et créer des opportunités d’auto-emploi pour les jeunes comoriens de 15-35 ans, à travers une approche centrée sur l’insertion des apprenants, le renforcement des capacités et la concertation entre le secteur public-privé et la société civile. L'assistance technique appuiera notamment: 1) la gestion administrative et financière, suivi-évaluation, coordination et communication;2) l'élaboration de parcours formation et insertion;3) les centres publics et acteurs institutionnels de la formation technique et professionnelle;4) les initiatives de la société civile et du secteur privé;5) la gouvernance multipartite et expérimentation du financement public.

description: Dans le but d'améliorer la gestion durable de ses ressources forestières, la République du Congo s'est engagée en 2008 dans la négociation d'un Accord de partenariat volontaire (APV) pour l’application des réglementations forestières, la gouvernance et les échanges commerciaux (FLEGT en acronyme anglais pour Forest Law Enforcement, Governance and Trade) avec l'Union européenne. L'accord est entré officiellement en vigueur le 1.3.2013.Le Système de vérification de la légalité (SVL) de l'APV de la République du Congo est composé de six éléments dont un audit indépendant. Depuis 2015, un Auditeur indépendant du système (AIS) est présent en République du Congo dans le but de s'assurer de la performance et de l'efficience du système de vérification de la légalité en cours de mise en œuvre. Le précédent contrat étant arrivé à échéance en 2019, le présent marché vise à mobiliser un nouvel auditeur indépendant.

description:
Le Parlement européen est à la recherche d’une agence bancaire qui devra s’installer dans son complexe immobilier à Strasbourg. 
Les espaces bancaires seront mis à disposition à titre gratuit ; cependant, le concessionnaire sera tenu de régler sa quote-part dans les charges liées à l'exploitation des locaux en question (quote-part de la consommation d'électricité et d'eau, ainsi que des frais de nettoyage, maintenance et gardiennage de l'immeuble). En cas de modification des surfaces, la redevance sera recalculée en conséquence.
Cette quote-part forfaitaire s'élève à 160 € par m2 par an. 
La concession sera attribuée à l’offre économiquement la plus avantageuse parmi celles négociées avec les sociétés bancaires dont les qualifications seront en adéquation avec le concept recherché par le Parlement européen.

description: The overall objective of this project is to reduce depletion of natural resources used in production processes and amount of waste generated by promoting usage of secondary raw materials and enhancing market for high quality recyclables. In order to contribute to the sustainable development, the contract will include technical assistance and institutional capacity building activities for identification and effective implementation of end-of-waste criteria for specific waste streams. Mainly, current situation in Turkey will be assessed by means of demanding sectors of waste streams such as metal, scrap, glass cullet, copper scrap, waste paper, biodegradable waste, waste plastic, textile waste etc. Besides, draft technical regulations on establishing criteria determining when certain types of materials cease to be waste, will be prepared compatible with Turkish context. Also guiding documents as draft regulations, roadmap and guidelines will be composed as the national strategy.
title: Technical Assistance for Development of End-of-Waste Concept in Turkey

description: Dans le but d'améliorer la gestion durable de ses ressources forestières, la République du Congo s'est engagée en 2008 dans la négociation d'un Accord de Partenariat Volontaire (APV) pour l’application des règlementations forestières, la gouvernance et les échanges commerciaux (FLEGT en acronyme anglais pour Forest Law Enforcement, Governance and Trade) avec l'Union européenne. L'accord est entré officiellement en vigueur le 1er mars 2013. Le système de vérification de la légalité (SVL) de l'APV de la République du Congo est composé de six éléments dont un audit indépendant. Depuis 2015, un Auditeur Indépendant du Système (AIS) est présent en République du Congo dans le but de s'assurer de la performance et de l'efficience du système de vérification de la légalité en cours de mise en œuvre. Le précédent contrat étant arrivé à échéance en 2019, le présent marché vise à mobiliser un nouvel auditeur indépendant.
title: Audit indépendant du système (AIS) de vérification de la légalité du système FLEGT République du Congo

description: The main objective of the contract is to increase the competitiveness of the TR82 Region through supporting SMEs active in seafood/fishery and tourism sectors in the Region, by improving production and market conditions and connections with new and existing markets. The TA services will be provided under group of three main activities namely, i) Operationalization of Fish Processing and Storage Centre, ii) Operationalization of SME Support Centre and iii) Competitiveness Study for Tourism sector. For achieving these objectives, the technical assistance services will be focused on diagnostic studies and business consultancy and development services provided to the Tourism and Fishery SME Support Centre (SSC) and seafood/fishery and tourism SMEs of the region, as well as preparation of tourism master plan, cluster analysis, tourism strategy document and windows projects for the Region.

description: El trabajo específico de este contrato forma parte de un proceso organizativo institucional en evolución. El Sistema Nacional de Formación Laboral –SINAFOL- se configura como un proceso avanzado, con muchos instrumentos técnicos elaborados que necesitan ser validados por importantes entidades del sector, como Instituto Técnico de Capacitación y Productividad - INTECAP, y progresivamente institucionalizados. Todo esto, con la finalidad de reorganizar la educación técnica profesional publica para que esté más vinculada a las necesidades del mercado laboral, mejorando la empleabilidad. Las acciones previstas responden a las necesidades de consolidación del SINAFOL por un lado y a la necesidad de ir avanzando en sucesivas etapas de desarrollo del Sistema. Para tales fines se abordarán a) los procesos de institucionalización y gobernanza del SINAFOL b) aspectos técnicos y metodológicos, c) planificación/implementación de nuevas etapas y productos, d) implementación de pilotajes.

description: The government of the Republic of Tunisia, through the promoter (STEG), has requested the EIB to finance its distribution network rehabilitation programme (the ‘Project’) for the period 2020-2025, with the aim of upgrading and modernising its MV/LV network. For Tunisia, the general objective of the Project is to strengthen the national electricity transmission and distribution system, for better coverage of the demand for electricity.
